newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Endemol pulls out of A'dam leisure scheme.
newsitem.headline: Endemol pulls out of A'dam leisure scheme.

text.p: Dutch television production company Endemol Entertainment NV said on Friday it had decided to withraw from a planned entertainment complex near the new Arena sports stadium in south-east Amsterdam.
Endemol said co-chairman Jaap van den Ende informed Amsterdam local government representatives of the company's decision earlier today.
It said he did not believe the region had the right character to attract people to the theatre in the evening.

Endemol had chosen this part of Amsterdam in the middle of 1995 for a complex to include two musical theatres, seating 1,000 and 2,000 people respectively, plus two hotels with a total of 250 rooms, and a ballroom.
The company already operates the Circustheater musical theatre in Scheveningen, near the Hague.
However, Endemol said it had asked the city council to resume talks with a view to finding a suitable alternative location.
"We still really want to develop a theatre in the capital," van den Ende said in a statement.
